description: List a space's real topics — the filing destinations you can hand to the `topicIds` param of naumu_delegate or naumu_ask when creating a thread. Filing a new thread into one or more topics makes it visible to those topics' members from birth (instead of the default private thread). Each row carries { id, name, visibilityMode, memberCount, openToWeb }; use the id values in `topicIds`. Topics have no separate description field. The virtual #misc bucket is not a real topic and is omitted; archived topics are omitted because they can't be tagged. Resolve `graphId` via naumu_list_graphs first.

graphId.description: The space (graph) id to list topics for.

name: naumu_list_topics
title: List Topics
